title: Rockwall County Historical Foundation Museum

services.name: Gazebo Rental
services.desc: This stunning structure is located next to a fountain pond surrounded by beautiful native foliage. It is the ideal location for a wedding proposal or ceremony, a fun birthday party or a special occasion such as graduation photos. A rental agreement to secure your reservation must be completed, signed and returned to the museum before paying any fees. The gazebo is private property of the Rockwall County HistoricalFoundation (RCHF). RCHF does not have alternative indoor or outdoor space available in the event of inclement weather. services.desc: Originally scheduled to close at the end of June, My Mosaic Inspiration has been extended to July 30. Fall in love with the unqiue beauty of fine art mosaics made with glass or natural stone! The artists of the Friday Morning Collective, which meets at Barbara Dybala’s Hidden Mosaic Studio, share their love of mosaic art with you in this exhibit, capturing subjects both natural and sublime. blurb: The RCHF Museum conveniently sits within Harry Myers Park in downtown Rockwall, Texas. The Museum Park is home to many historic structures including two homes from early Rockwall County, a Tenant Cabin, the Hartman Windmill, a replica carriage house, outhouse, and gazebo. The Blackland Prairie Grassland is a preservation project of native grass and wildflowers.
